# UnicodeKruti — Key pages for AI crawlers

- Homepage: https://unicodekruti.com/ — Free Unicode to KrutiDev converter for Hindi text

- KrutiDev 10 Converter: https://unicodekruti.com/krutidev-10-to-unicode-converter/ — Kurtidev10 to Unicode
- KrutiDev 010 Converter: https://unicodekruti.com/krutidev-010-to-unicode-converter/ — Government standard converter
- Unicode to KrutiDev 10: https://unicodekruti.com/unicode-to-krutidev-10-converter/ — Mangal to KrutiDev 10
- Updesh Converter: https://unicodekruti.com/updesh-converter/ — Updesh / Updes ↔ Unicode for UP government typing
